transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, thank you. Well, what finally made me come in today is that I just keep forgetting really basic adult things. It's like... I forget to pay my bills, I don't return interview emails, I don't show up for appointments, and I just can't seem to follow through on normal everyday errands. It's gotten to the point where it's starting to cost me real opportunities, so I knew I needed to see someone and figure out what's going on.
When did you first start having these difficulties with remembering and following through on everyday tasks?

I'd say it's been seriously affecting me for about a year and two months now. It started right around the time things started falling apart at my job at a biotech company... and it's just continued ever since I got fired from there.
Did you experience similar difficulties with attention or forgetfulness when you were growing up in school?

Yeah, actually. Even back in... well, as early as elementary school, really. My teachers would always write on my report cards that I was bright, but I was just constantly losing my worksheets. I'd always rush through the directions, and I talked out of turn a lot. And my desk was always so messy that I literally couldn't find my assignments when it was time to hand them in. So, yeah, it's been an issue for a long time.
Do you often feel physically restless inside, or have difficulty sitting still for extended periods?

Yes, definitely. Whenever I have to sit through something—like an interview, a meeting, or even just watching a movie—I get this intense pressure inside my body. It feels like I just need to get up, or shift around, or do something with my hands. If I can't move, it honestly feels like I'm going to crawl out of my skin.
